name: coat_chest_body
where: Front torso of the long coat, x about 0.36-0.58, y 0.64-0.86, between the two shoulder-armour bases and down to the belt line at y about 0.64.
shape: Smooth dark-blue double-breasted coat torso with soft folds across the belly and chest.
notes: Two overlapping front panels under the lapels and buttons. Continues below y 0.64 into the coat skirt, which is outside this region.

name: coat_back_panel
where: Upper back of the coat between the shoulder armour, x about 0.28-0.58, y about 0.66-0.86, from the collar to the belt line.
shape: Broad dark-blue back panel with shallow horizontal folds and a slight shoulder-blade curve.
in_reference: differs: the reference back is decorated with gold trim and crosses; the sculpt back is plain cloth with no trim geometry
notes: Plain surface in the sculpt. Gold paint streaks are paint only, not geometry.

name: back_centre_gold_trim
where: Vertical strip down the centre back, from the collar at y about 0.86 to the belt at y about 0.64, at x about 0.44.
shape: Narrow gold piping strip running straight down the spine of the coat.
in_reference: differs: the sculpt lacks this strip entirely
notes: Missing from the sculpt. Reference shows it continuing from the collar to the hem with cross motifs (see back_centre_cross_emblems).

name: back_centre_cross_emblems
where: Two gold cross-shaped ornaments on the centre back: one at the shoulder blades, y about 0.80, and one at the waist, y about 0.70.
shape: Pattee-style gothic cross, flat or slightly raised, with flared arms.
in_reference: differs: present in the reference, absent from the sculpt
notes: Sculpt lacks them. Paint streaks in the sculpt do not form a cross.

name: back_yoke_seam
where: Shallow curved seam across the upper back from the shoulder-armour roots at y about 0.82 down toward the mid-back at y about 0.74.
shape: Faint yoke line, like a seam crease, sweeping from each shoulder toward the centre back.
notes: Could be a fold rather than a seam. Only visible in the clay views.

name: stand_collar
where: Tall stand collar around the neck, y about 0.83-0.88, centre x about 0.46, rising behind the neck and forming the lapel roots at the front.
shape: High band of dark-blue cloth with a gold top edge, flaring at the front points.
notes: Front collar points overlap the lapels. Upper edge is gold-trimmed in the tex views. Neck and hat region is out of scope.

name: neck_underlayer
where: Near-black high neck underlayer visible in the V between the lapels, y about 0.78-0.86, x about 0.44-0.50.
shape: Narrow near-black inner collar or shirt band rising to the mask's neck.
notes: Layered under the lapels. May belong to the head or neck region rather than the chest.

name: lapel_right
where: Diamond-shaped notch lapel on the character's right (viewer's left in the front panel), x about 0.39-0.46, y about 0.66-0.82.
shape: Flat diamond-shaped lapel panel angled down from the collar toward the waist.
notes: Sits over the chest panel. Gold piping on its outer edge. Left and right lapels are mirror images.

name: lapel_left
where: Diamond-shaped notch lapel on the character's left (viewer's right in the front panel), x about 0.48-0.55, y about 0.66-0.82.
shape: Flat diamond-shaped lapel panel, mirror of lapel_right, overlapping the centre.
notes: Overlaps lapel_right at the centre front. Gold piping on its outer edge.

name: lapel_piping_gold
where: Gold edging along the outer edges of each lapel, from the collar points down to the lower lapel tip near y about 0.66.
shape: Thin raised gold bead or strip following the lapel outline.
notes: Clay shows it as a raised ridge, so it is probably geometry. One per lapel.

name: lapel_tip_studs
where: One round stud near the top of each lapel: character's right at about x 0.405, y 0.79; character's left at about x 0.52, y 0.79.
shape: Small domed gold stud or rivet.
notes: Symmetric pair.

name: double_breast_buttons
where: Two columns of three domed gold buttons. Columns at x about 0.43 (viewer left, character's right) and x about 0.51 (character's left). Rows at y about 0.72, 0.68 and 0.64.
shape: Round domed gold button, roughly 0.02 across.
notes: Three per column, six in total. Buttons are sculpted as separate domes on the coat front. Counted once as a repeated item.

name: front_placket_trim
where: Vertical gold piping along each front closure edge, from the lapel roots at y about 0.80 down to the hem, at x about 0.42 and 0.52.
shape: Thin gold strip running parallel to the button columns.
notes: Clay shows a faint raised edge. Reference shows a continuous gold front trim to the hem.

name: waist_buckle_tab_centre
where: Rectangular tab at the centre front just above the belt, x about 0.44-0.49, y about 0.62-0.66, with two small buttons.
shape: Flat tab with a notch and two domed buttons.
notes: Sits on the belt line, so it may belong to the belt region rather than the chest. Two buttons are counted here.

name: armhole_rim_left
where: Circular opening of the left armhole, about 0.10-0.12 across, centred near x about 0.60-0.62, y about 0.76-0.80.
shape: Rolled cloth ring around the arm opening with a clear inner void.
notes: Mesh is open here (hole in the sculpt). Coat cloth dark blue to near-black at the cuff edge.

name: armhole_rim_right
where: Circular opening of the right armhole, about 0.10-0.12 across, centred near x about 0.32-0.34, y about 0.76-0.80.
shape: Rolled cloth ring around the arm opening.
notes: Mirror of armhole_rim_left. Open mesh at the sleeve.

name: armhole_cord_left
where: Rounded cord running around the left armhole, just inside the rim, about y 0.74-0.80.
shape: Thick rounded piping or cord.
notes: Concentric rings in the clay could be folds rather than a cord. Sleeve interior is not in this region.

name: armhole_cord_right
where: Rounded cord running around the right armhole, just inside the rim, about y 0.74-0.80.
shape: Thick rounded piping or cord.
notes: Mirror of armhole_cord_left.

name: pauldron_arch_band_left
where: Arched band over the top of the left shoulder, x about 0.56-0.68, y about 0.82-0.86, running front to back over the armhole.
shape: Curved gold-edged plate band like a horseshoe over the shoulder cap.
notes: Strongest plate in the assembly. Studs run along its length (pauldron_studs_left). Sits over pauldron_lower_arch_left.

name: pauldron_front_strap_left
where: Vertical strap crossing the front of the left shoulder, x about 0.60-0.64, y about 0.80-0.86.
shape: Narrow gold-edged strap with a rounded end, running down the front of the shoulder.
notes: Lies over pauldron_wing_plate_left. Has a raised end stud (counted in pauldron_studs_left).

name: pauldron_wing_plate_left
where: Fan-shaped wing plate reaching outward and down the upper arm from the shoulder, x about 0.60-0.70, y about 0.78-0.84.
shape: Flat wedge plate with a pointed outer tip and gold edge.
notes: Lies under the front strap. Gold edge follows the outline.

name: pauldron_lower_arch_left
where: Second, smaller arch under pauldron_arch_band_left, following the top of the armhole, about y 0.78-0.82.
shape: Inner curved plate, like a second arc of the same horseshoe.
notes: Sits between the outer arch and the armhole rim.

name: pauldron_studs_left
where: Domed gold rivets: about 6 along pauldron_arch_band_left, 4 on pauldron_front_strap_left, 2 on pauldron_wing_plate_left, 3 on pauldron_lower_arch_left, across x about 0.56-0.70, y about 0.78-0.86.
shape: Round domed rivet, roughly 0.01-0.015 across.
notes: Count is approximate per plate. Repeated items counted once with a total.

name: pauldron_edge_trim_left
where: Gold bevelled edging around the outer rims of the left pauldron plates, x about 0.56-0.70, y about 0.78-0.86.
shape: Raised gold rim bevel following each plate outline.
notes: Clay shows a raised bevel, so probably geometry, but it could be paint-only.

name: pauldron_emblem_left
where: Cross or star medallion on the left pauldron, about x 0.60, y 0.82-0.84.
shape: Gothic cross or star emblem, gold.
in_reference: differs: reference has a clear cross or star emblem; sculpt has only painted gold streaks
notes: Sculpt lacks any raised emblem geometry.

name: underarm_torn_flap_left
where: Jagged torn cloth edge at the back underarm of the left side, x about 0.60-0.64, y about 0.66-0.74.
shape: Broken, ragged edge of cloth, likely a sculpt artifact.
notes: May be a real tattered edge in the design or a scan hole. Confirm before modelling.

name: pauldron_arch_band_right
where: Arched band over the top of the right shoulder, x about 0.26-0.36, y about 0.82-0.86, running front to back over the armhole.
shape: Curved gold-edged plate band like a horseshoe over the shoulder cap.
notes: Mirror of pauldron_arch_band_left.

name: pauldron_front_strap_right
where: Vertical strap crossing the front of the right shoulder, x about 0.28-0.33, y about 0.80-0.86.
shape: Narrow gold-edged strap with a rounded end.
notes: Mirror of pauldron_front_strap_left.

name: pauldron_wing_plate_right
where: Fan-shaped wing plate outboard of the right shoulder, x about 0.26-0.36, y about 0.78-0.84.
shape: Flat wedge plate with a pointed outer tip and gold edge.
notes: Mirror of pauldron_wing_plate_left.

name: pauldron_lower_arch_right
where: Second, smaller arch under pauldron_arch_band_right, following the top of the armhole, about y 0.78-0.82.
shape: Inner curved plate, the second arc of the horseshoe.
notes: Mirror of pauldron_lower_arch_left.

name: pauldron_studs_right
where: Domed gold rivets: about 6 along pauldron_arch_band_right, 4 on pauldron_front_strap_right, 2 on pauldron_wing_plate_right, 3 on pauldron_lower_arch_right, across x about 0.26-0.36, y about 0.78-0.86.
shape: Round domed rivet, roughly 0.01-0.015 across.
notes: Mirror of pauldron_studs_left. Counts per plate are approximate.

name: pauldron_edge_trim_right
where: Gold bevelled edging around the outer rims of the right pauldron plates, x about 0.26-0.36, y about 0.78-0.86.
shape: Raised gold rim bevel following each plate outline.
notes: Mirror of pauldron_edge_trim_left.

name: pauldron_emblem_right
where: Cross or star medallion on the right pauldron, about x 0.31, y 0.82-0.84.
shape: Gothic cross or star emblem, gold.
in_reference: differs: reference has a clear cross or star emblem; sculpt has only painted gold streaks
notes: Mirror of pauldron_emblem_left.

name: underarm_torn_flap_right
where: Jagged torn cloth edge at the back underarm of the right side, x about 0.28-0.32, y about 0.66-0.74.
shape: Broken, ragged edge of cloth, likely a sculpt artifact.
notes: Mirror of underarm_torn_flap_left. Confirm whether this is design or scan damage.
